title: Trombonists in St. Louis and bringing in Fernando
summary: He names trombonists and says he sent for Fernando, a Mexican player he knew from the Sissle band.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from

blocks.x: Who were some of the other trombone players who were active at that time?
There was a fella, Abdul Hamid (phonetic spelling), he's in New York now, I don't know who he's playing with right now, and I can't think of the trombone players that were there in St. Louis, though

he was one. He had two trombone players. At one time I had Fernando Venis'cia. Mexican fella that I had put in with me with Noble Sissle on the west coast. I sent for Fernando and Fernando came and joined us when I was with Jeter-Pillars.
